source.note: Hypertension: 'usual initial dose ... 25 mg daily given as a single dose', may increase to '50 mg daily, given as a single or two divided doses'.
The single-ingredient label gives none; this olmesartan/HCTZ label: 'estimated absolute bioavailability of hydrochlorothiazide ... is about 70%'
'plasma half-life has been observed to vary between 5.6 and 14.8 hours' (olmesartan/HCTZ label: about 10 h) model = midpoint of the label range (curve value; change if you prefer another)

source.citation: Chen TM, Chiou WL. Large differences in the biological half-life and volume of distribution of hydrochlorothiazide in normal subjects from eleven studies. Int J Clin Pharmacol Ther Toxicol. 1992;30(1):34-7 (PMID 1551742)
source.note: No label gives Vd. Abstract: mean Vdarea across 11 studies 'from 1.53 to 4.19 l/kg' (and studies with short sampling underestimate it). model = midpoint of the label range (curve value; change if you prefer another)
'Peak plasma hydrochlorothiazide concentrations (Cmax) are reached within 2 to 5 hours' model = midpoint of the label range (curve value; change if you prefer another)
'not metabolized but is eliminated rapidly by the kidney'; 'At least 61% of the oral dose is eliminated unchanged within 24 hours' (a bound, so no fraction).

journey.text: About 70% of a dose is absorbed from the gut, peaking 2 to 5 hours later.
Makes the kidneys flush out more salt and water, lowering the amount of fluid in the blood vessels and with it blood pressure.
Not broken down at all: it leaves unchanged in urine.
